잠언-16-1.title: 잠언 16장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-1.exegesis: 33. The fear ... wisdom-- Wisdom instructs in true piety. before ... humility-- (compare Lu 24:26 ; 1Pe 1:11 ); opposite (compare Pr 16:18 ).
잠언-16-1.theologicalNote: 33. The fear ... wisdom-- Wisdom instructs in true piety. before ... humility-- (compare Lu 24:26 ; 1Pe 1:11 ); opposite (compare Pr 16:18 ).

잠언-16-2.title: 잠언 16장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 16 Pr 16:1-33 . 1. preparations-- schemes. in man-- or literally, "to man," belonging, or pertaining to him. the answer ... Lord-- The efficient ordering is from God: "Man proposes; God disposes."
잠언-16-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 16 Pr 16:1-33 . 1. preparations-- schemes. in man-- or literally, "to man," belonging, or pertaining to him. the answer ... Lord-- The efficient ordering is from God: "Man proposes; God disposes."

잠언-16-3.title: 잠언 16장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-3.exegesis: 2. clean-- or, "faultless." weigheth-- or, "tries," "judges," implying that they are faulty ( Pr 21:2 ; 24:12 ).
잠언-16-3.theologicalNote: 2. clean-- or, "faultless." weigheth-- or, "tries," "judges," implying that they are faulty ( Pr 21:2 ; 24:12 ).

잠언-16-4.title: 잠언 16장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-4.exegesis: 3. (Compare Margin). Rely on God for success to your lawful purposes.
잠언-16-4.theologicalNote: 3. (Compare Margin). Rely on God for success to your lawful purposes.

잠언-16-5.title: 잠언 16장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-5.exegesis: 4. for himself-- "for its answer," or "purpose," that is, according to God's plan; the wicked are for the day of evil ( Psa 49:5 ; Jr 17:18 ); sinning and suffering answer to each other, are indissolubly united.
잠언-16-5.theologicalNote: 4. for himself-- "for its answer," or "purpose," that is, according to God's plan; the wicked are for the day of evil ( Psa 49:5 ; Jr 17:18 ); sinning and suffering answer to each other, are indissolubly united.

잠언-16-7.title: 잠언 16장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-7.exegesis: 6. By mercy and truth-- that is, God's ( Psa 85:10 ); He effects the atonement, or covering of sin; and the principles of true piety incline men to depart from evil; or, "mercy" and "truth" may be man's, indicative of the gracious tempers which work instrumentally in procuring pardon. purged-- expiated (as in Le 16:33 ; Is 27:9 , Hebrew).
잠언-16-7.theologicalNote: 6. By mercy and truth-- that is, God's ( Psa 85:10 ); He effects the atonement, or covering of sin; and the principles of true piety incline men to depart from evil; or, "mercy" and "truth" may be man's, indicative of the gracious tempers which work instrumentally in procuring pardon. purged-- expiated (as in Le 16:33 ; Is 27:9 , Hebrew).

잠언-16-11.title: 잠언 16장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-11.exegesis: 10. The last clause depends on the first, expressing the importance of equity in decisions, so authoritative.
잠언-16-11.theologicalNote: 10. The last clause depends on the first, expressing the importance of equity in decisions, so authoritative.

잠언-16-12.title: 잠언 16장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-12.exegesis: 11. are the Lord's ... his work-- that is, what He has ordered, and hence should be observed by men.
잠언-16-12.theologicalNote: 11. are the Lord's ... his work-- that is, what He has ordered, and hence should be observed by men.

잠언-16-13.title: 잠언 16장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-13.exegesis: 12. Rulers are rightly expected, by their position, to hate evil; for their power is sustained by righteousness.
잠언-16-13.theologicalNote: 12. Rulers are rightly expected, by their position, to hate evil; for their power is sustained by righteousness.

잠언-16-14.title: 잠언 16장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-14.exegesis: 13. A specification of the general sentiment of Pr 16:12 .
잠언-16-14.theologicalNote: 13. A specification of the general sentiment of Pr 16:12 .

잠언-16-15.title: 잠언 16장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-15.exegesis: 14. This wrath, so terrible and certain, like messengers of death ( 1Ki 2:25 ), can be appeased by the wise.
잠언-16-15.theologicalNote: 14. This wrath, so terrible and certain, like messengers of death ( 1Ki 2:25 ), can be appeased by the wise.

잠언-16-16.title: 잠언 16장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-16.exegesis: 15. light of ... countenance-- favor ( Psa 4:6 ). life-- preserves it, or gives blessings which make it valuable. the latter rain-- fell just before harvest and matured the crop; hence specially valuable ( De 11:14 ).
잠언-16-16.theologicalNote: 15. light of ... countenance-- favor ( Psa 4:6 ). life-- preserves it, or gives blessings which make it valuable. the latter rain-- fell just before harvest and matured the crop; hence specially valuable ( De 11:14 ).

잠언-16-18.title: 잠언 16장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-18.exegesis: 17. The highway-- A common, plain road represents the habitual course of the righteous in departing from evil. keepeth-- observes.
잠언-16-18.theologicalNote: 17. The highway-- A common, plain road represents the habitual course of the righteous in departing from evil. keepeth-- observes.

잠언-16-19.title: 잠언 16장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-19.exegesis: 18-19. (Compare Pr 15:33 ). Haughtiness and pride imply self-confidence which produces carelessness, and hence a fall-- literally, "sliding."
잠언-16-19.theologicalNote: 18-19. (Compare Pr 15:33 ). Haughtiness and pride imply self-confidence which produces carelessness, and hence a fall-- literally, "sliding."

잠언-16-20.title: 잠언 16장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-20.exegesis: 18-19. (Compare Pr 15:33 ). Haughtiness and pride imply self-confidence which produces carelessness, and hence a fall-- literally, "sliding."
잠언-16-20.theologicalNote: 18-19. (Compare Pr 15:33 ). Haughtiness and pride imply self-confidence which produces carelessness, and hence a fall-- literally, "sliding."

잠언-16-21.title: 잠언 16장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-21.exegesis: 20. handleth a matter-- wisely considers "the word," that is, of God (compare Pr 13:13 ). trusteth-- (Compare Psa 2:12 ; 118:8, 9).
잠언-16-21.theologicalNote: 20. handleth a matter-- wisely considers "the word," that is, of God (compare Pr 13:13 ). trusteth-- (Compare Psa 2:12 ; 118:8, 9).

잠언-16-22.title: 잠언 16장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-22.exegesis: 21. wise in heart-- who rightly consider duty. sweetness of the lips-- eloquent discourse, persuades and instructs others.
잠언-16-22.theologicalNote: 21. wise in heart-- who rightly consider duty. sweetness of the lips-- eloquent discourse, persuades and instructs others.

잠언-16-23.title: 잠언 16장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-23.exegesis: 22. Understanding-- or, "discretion," is a constant source of blessing ( Pr 13:14 ), benefiting others; but fools' best efforts are folly.
잠언-16-23.theologicalNote: 22. Understanding-- or, "discretion," is a constant source of blessing ( Pr 13:14 ), benefiting others; but fools' best efforts are folly.

잠언-16-24.title: 잠언 16장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-24.exegesis: 23. The heart is the source of wisdom flowing from the mouth.
잠언-16-24.theologicalNote: 23. The heart is the source of wisdom flowing from the mouth.

잠언-16-25.title: 잠언 16장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-25.exegesis: 24. (Compare Pr 15:26 ). Gentle, kind words, by soothing the mind, give the body health.
잠언-16-25.theologicalNote: 24. (Compare Pr 15:26 ). Gentle, kind words, by soothing the mind, give the body health.

잠언-16-27.title: 잠언 16장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-27.exegesis: 26. Diligence is a duty due to one's self, for his wants require labor.
잠언-16-27.theologicalNote: 26. Diligence is a duty due to one's self, for his wants require labor.

잠언-16-28.title: 잠언 16장 28절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-28.exegesis: 27. ungodly man-- (Compare Pr 6:12 ). diggeth up evil-- labors for it. in his lips ... fire-- His words are calumniating ( Jas 3:6 ).
잠언-16-28.theologicalNote: 27. ungodly man-- (Compare Pr 6:12 ). diggeth up evil-- labors for it. in his lips ... fire-- His words are calumniating ( Jas 3:6 ).

잠언-16-30.title: 잠언 16장 30절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-30.exegesis: 29. violent man-- or, "man of mischief" ( Pr 3:31 ). enticeth-- ( Pr 1:10 ).
잠언-16-30.theologicalNote: 29. violent man-- or, "man of mischief" ( Pr 3:31 ). enticeth-- ( Pr 1:10 ).

잠언-16-31.title: 잠언 16장 31절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-31.exegesis: 30. He shutteth his eyes-- denoting deep thought ( Psa 64:6 ). moving his lips-- or, "biting his lips"--a determined purpose ( Pr 6:13 ).
잠언-16-31.theologicalNote: 30. He shutteth his eyes-- denoting deep thought ( Psa 64:6 ). moving his lips-- or, "biting his lips"--a determined purpose ( Pr 6:13 ).

잠언-16-32.title: 잠언 16장 32절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-32.exegesis: 31. (Compare Pr 20:29 ). if-- or, which may be supplied properly, or without it the sense is as in Pr 3:16 ; 4:10 , that piety is blessed with long life.
잠언-16-32.theologicalNote: 31. (Compare Pr 20:29 ). if-- or, which may be supplied properly, or without it the sense is as in Pr 3:16 ; 4:10 , that piety is blessed with long life.

잠언-16-33.title: 잠언 16장 33절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-16-33.exegesis: 32. (Compare Pr 14:29 ). taketh a city-- that is, by fighting.
잠언-16-33.theologicalNote: 32. (Compare Pr 14:29 ). taketh a city-- that is, by fighting.
